stations.name: 新白河
stations.notes: BVE terminal-era platform takes priority; the historical video shows a different through layout. Player route remains connected toward Fukushima.

limitations: BVE lateral interpolation is rendered with smooth prototype curves, not an exact BVE engine.
Northern rail positions use the retained OSM survey; platform side and general station form use inspected video frames.
Platform lengths, width beyond source edge strips, roof, stairs and buildings are approximate.
Historical video and current OSM/BVE may represent different eras; no original .x model, texture or video frame is redistributed.
